description.en: Skill and expert matcher for DeepSeek Harness. Reads the user's need and recommends the most relevant local skill, marketplace skill, expert, or open-source entry, with top-N ranking and install guidance.
description.zh: 技能与专家匹配器（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。读懂用户需求，从本地技能、市场技能、专家与开源条目中匹配并推荐最相关者，输出 Top-N 排序与安装方式。
